## 0.2.28

- Restore middle-click sorting for the hovered backpack, chest or player inventory.
- Deposit matching loose items into backpacks on the sorted surface while retaining all remainders.
- Add safe death-backpack one-click equipment for empty armor slots.
- Support bundle-style left/right-click item transfers and mouse-wheel selection for ordinary backpacks.
- Share ordinary and death backpack sidebars across inventory, crafting, enchanting and chest screens. Materials can be moved manually into native workstation slots.
- Preserve captured backpacks and their contents when sorting death storage; new nesting remains forbidden.
- Add module-owned native read-only Observer sidebar reconstruction with privacy and input suppression.

Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric; requires TotemCore 0.7.23. Observer sidebar support is provided by the companion Observer update. Additional UI families are not included.
